# A6b results (generated by musedark_qi.py; do not edit)

Editorial analysis. SED budgets partition the total stellar mass at the released stellar B/T; molecular gas follows the disc. Bootstrap fractions describe resampled fits, not posterior probabilities or calibrated rejection probabilities.

Rebuilt galaxies: 88; usable (0.33 < z < 1.44, SED log M★ > 8.8, data beyond 2.2 kpc): 86.
Anchor: rebuilt v_⊥(2 kpc) / release v2kpc = 0.998 (16–84%: 0.943–1.079, N = 87).
